basics.name: Laxmi Narsimha Reddy Jammula
basics.label: Senior Engineering Manager
basics.summary: Dedicated Engineering Leader / Full Stack Developer with 14+ years of experience developing enterprise applications using Go, Java, C#, Python, relational databases, and JavaScript. Experienced in managing cross-functional teams and integrating Data Science/Machine Learning solutions. Strong track record in delivering results through agile methodologies. Recent 2026 work has focused on building and operating agentic AI systems independently -- coding-agent harness engineering, local LLM infrastructure, and autonomous research agents -- alongside core engineering-management responsibilities.

projects.name: Coding-agent harness engineering & evaluation
projects.description: Hardened and customized the Pi coding-agent harness for daily use (pinned TypeScript contract test suite, current-diff quality gate, project-scoped config overlays, stack-aware routing, external-effect guard, symlink-safe path checks, versioned trace records, Docker containment profile). Designed and ran controlled agentic-coding benchmarks (Harbor framework, blinded model-based review, replicated trials) comparing Claude Code, Codex CLI, Copilot CLI, and Pi across Go and Flutter/Dart tasks. Diagnosed a decoding-configuration regression that flipped a replicated benchmark result from 0/4 to 4/4, and built supporting evaluation tooling (stall detection, wall-clock budget nudging).

projects.name: Local LLM infrastructure
projects.description: Operated multi-host local LLM inference infrastructure across two hardware generations: an NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10) two-host cluster running llama-swap behind a LiteLLM proxy with Tailscale remote access, then a consolidated Apple MLX stack on a Mac Studio M3 Ultra serving code-generation, chat, web-search, and speech-to-text models concurrently, with validated rollback procedures for every model swap. Also evaluates OpenClaw, a separate autonomous coding agent, alongside Claude Code and Pi.

projects.name: Personal multi-agent assistant (Hermes)
projects.description: Operates a personal AI assistant built on distinct agent profiles -- a coding agent, a research agent, and a Kanban-style orchestrator agent -- driven by cron-scheduled prompts, including one that runs an ongoing product-idea research pipeline end to end.

projects.name: DayTrix
projects.description: Cross-platform productivity app (reminders, checklists, notes, habits, mood, routines, daily briefing), one Flutter codebase to web, iOS, and Android, backed by a Go API. Live on the web at https://personal-assistant-kkkbm3cwkq-uc.a.run.app (Google Cloud Run); iOS ships via Xcode Cloud -> TestFlight. CI/CD to Cloud Run, Firebase backend, Playwright end-to-end coverage.

projects.name: Personal Budget Simplifier
projects.description: A second Go + Flutter cross-platform app (macOS, Windows, Linux, Web, iOS) for CSV-based personal budget tracking, with a pure-Go SQLite backend.

projects.name: Autonomous research agents
projects.description: Operate a nightly automated financial-research pipeline (FinRobot-based) covering 60 tickers and indices with automated retry/failure handling. Maintain a running daily research log tracking Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A) developments, kept continuously since mid-2026. Built an MCP server (Go + Python) exposing a task-management agent.
